title: autospec-fab model sidecar
description: Per-model metadata sidecar describing geometry, material, ports, gaskets, and gate flags for the autospec-fab pipeline.

name.description: Optional human-readable model name; surfaced by the release-gate engine (stl-release-gate.py _model_name) into release-gate.json["name"].

body_count.description: Optional expected number of connected solid bodies; read by stage-geometry.py to set expect-bodies.

material.description: Filament or resin material designation (e.g. PETG, ABS, ASA).

print_orientation.description: Recommended print orientation (e.g. flat, upright, side).

load_critical.description: True when the part bears structural load and must pass FEA stage.

flow_critical.description: True when the part is in the vacuum/air-flow circuit and must pass CFD stage.

id.description: Unique port identifier within this model.

tap_access.description: NPT port: tap/wrench access is preserved (vacuum-fitting QA, #1224).

thread_depth_mm.description: NPT port: usable thread depth in mm (vacuum-fitting QA).

standalone_tower.description: Port is a narrow standalone tower/ear/boss rather than integrated into the body (vacuum-fitting QA rejects true).

id.description: Unique gasket identifier within this model.

groove.description: Groove profile type (e.g. o-ring, flat, dovetail).

surrounding_wall_mm.description: Minimum plastic wall surrounding the gasket groove in mm (gate requires ≥5 mm).

seal_face_continuous.description: Groove seal face is continuous/closed (gasket-leak QA rejects a broken seal face).

exposed_side.description: Groove side is open to the exterior (gasket-leak QA rejects true — exposed gasket side).
